assumptions.status: hypothetical behavioral parameters; not fitted to player data
assumptions.cashDecision: logistic score from streak, selected win probability, cashout size, next payout, bankroll exposure, session P/L, target attainment and recent wins
assumptions.tie: continue same choice; no repeated cashout sampling until a win
assumptions.gainProtection: bankroll/session gains encourage cashout depending on profile
assumptions.chasing: session deficit reduces cashout; two losses can raise wager one allowed tier, capped at 10000 and available balance
assumptions.settlement: floor final payout to integer LIA; cash out if selected next payout would exceed wallet INT limit
assumptions.draw: independent uniform draw from all 52 cards; ties 1/13, A/2 redraw, losing fate shift 1/1000
assumptions.horizon: profile-specific session limits; quit at loss/profit limits or bankroll exhaustion
assumptions.noClaims: type frequencies and coefficients are analyst-chosen sensitivity scenarios, not human population estimates
assumptions.expectedRtp: independent importance trajectory per real wager at actual pre-hand session state; estimate weighted by actual stake volume
assumptions.confidence: 95% approximate ratio intervals clustered by independent session; excludes model misspecification
